svg.title: Cycle time per issue — eight months (illustrative)
svg.desc: Scatter plot with a rolling average. 1600 issues over 8 months, about 7 arriving a day. Each dot is one closed issue, placed on the date it completed against the number of days it took. 1552 issues closed; the rolling mean holds near 0.9 days for the whole period while the plus or minus one sigma band widens from about 0.8 to about 2.0 days. A separate strip above the axis break holds the 48 issues - 3 percent - that have no completion date, so their cycle time is undefined rather than long; they are placed on the date they were created. Illustrative figures, not measured data.
